description: Random-capsule (role-label permutation) baseline for the Hub and Specialist within-vs-cross domain gaps: each role is compared with same-size groups of other capsules of the same models, evaluated under the canonical symmetric protocol, plus a descriptive all-roles companion table.

definitions.home: argmax over classes of the capsule's calibration importance column
definitions.within: per-capsule mean routing correctness over the images of its home class
definitions.cross: per-capsule mean routing correctness over the images of the other nine classes
definitions.within_pct / cross_pct: 100 x mean over units, equal weight per unit across models
definitions.logit_gap: logit(pooled mean within) - logit(pooled mean cross), group level
definitions.drawn_group_mean_role_share: mean over draws of the share of drawn units in each role

outside_role.pool_definition: every capsule of the model not in the compared role

home_matched.pool_definition: outside_role pool, drawn per home class to equal the role's home-class counts in that model
home_matched.label: INFEASIBLE as an exact home-count-matched draw. The pooled numbers, and the per-seed numbers of every seed marked post_stratified, are a POST-STRATIFIED estimate: in each short home class every available pool capsule is taken in every draw and weighted need/available, so the group carries the role's home-class composition; that class contributes no draw-to-draw variability, so the null band is slightly too narrow.

excl_nonpositive_importance.pool_definition: outside_role with capsules whose importance column is all <= 0 removed from the pool and from the observed group

outside_role.pool_definition: every capsule of the model not in the compared role

home_matched.pool_definition: outside_role pool, drawn per home class to equal the role's home-class counts in that model

excl_nonpositive_importance.pool_definition: outside_role with capsules whose importance column is all <= 0 removed from the pool and from the observed group

random_seed.null_rng: numpy default_rng([20261111, dataset_id, role_id, variant_id]) per cell
random_seed.bca_rng: numpy default_rng(0) pooled, default_rng(model slot id) per model, inside capsnet.stats.bca_bootstrap_ci
random_seed.note: The image pools are a deterministic slice; only the null draws and the BCa resampling consume RNGs.

_provenance.statistical_method: Role-label permutation null: per model, same-size groups drawn without replacement from the capsules outside the role (plus three pool variants), pooled across models with equal weight per unit; null mean, SD, 2.5/97.5 percentiles and two-sided resampling p for within, cross, additive gap and group-level logit gap. Companion: capsule-level BCa 95% CIs for every role.
